negative_v16: flat schematic, line drawing, collage, text, labels, logo, cropped rotor, disconnected arm, extra rotor, perspective camera, camera lens visible from above, upward-facing lens, camera on a neck or stalk, camera on a post, camera at the tail, dark module at the tail, V-shaped propeller, blades at an acute angle, single-blade propeller, missing blade, unequal blades
wl_text:
Design a compact quadcopter for everyday aerial photography. Strict orthographic top view, nose toward the top edge, arms fully unfolded.
Match the four motor centres and arm directions in the layout exactly. Each motor carries one stationary two-blade, 5-inch propeller. The two blades of each propeller are identical in length and width and point in exactly opposite directions from the hub, never a V shape. No propeller guards.
The nose points to the top edge of the image. The rear end of the fuselage is a closed, plain light grey shell: no dark part, opening, camera or module at the tail.
A rounded pod with a continuous curved outline.
Each arm grows out of the shell through a smooth seamless blend, with no joint line at the root.
The camera sits inside the nose, flush with the shell; from directly overhead only a thin dark strip of its front window shows at the very front edge of the nose. The camera faces horizontally forward.
A plain top cover with no seams crossing it.
Arms in the same matte light grey as the shell.
Matte light grey shell and arms in one continuous colour, dark grey motors, black propellers.
Show the complete product on a plain light background. Omit guide marks and lettering.
hexa_text:
Design one six-rotor agricultural plant-protection drone for crop spraying. Strict orthographic top view, nose toward the top edge, arms fully unfolded.
Match the six motor centres and arm directions in the layout exactly. Each motor carries one stationary two-blade propeller whose two blades are identical and point in exactly opposite directions from the hub, never a V shape. No propeller guards.
A square spray tank sits half-embedded in the central frame: the frame wraps the lower half of the tank, while the tank top and its round filler cap stay exposed.
A transverse spray boom runs across under the body and extends beyond both sides of the frame.
Each arm is attached to the frame by a visible folding hinge with a pivot pin.
Matte light grey frame and arms, white spray tank, dark grey motors, black propellers.
Show the complete product on a plain light background. Omit guide marks and lettering.
rev1_text: Edit this drone image. Change only the camera at the nose: remove the dark window strip embedded in the nose and add a small gimbal camera that hangs underneath the front of the fuselage, as on modern foldable camera drones. Seen from directly above, only the top edge of the small dark grey camera housing peeks out just ahead of the nose; the lens faces straight forward toward the top edge of the image, so no lens glass is visible from above. Keep everything else exactly the same: the strict orthographic top view, the body outline, the top cover panels and parting lines, the seamless arms, the motors with their orange rings, the two-blade propellers and their angles, the colours and the plain light background.
